inputs.text: Minimal flat vector app logo mark: an abstract letter A formed by two converging pillars crossed by a gently curved torii-gate-like crossbar, a small play triangle in negative space at the heart. Indigo to pink gradient fill. Centered on plain white background with margin. Crisp clean edges, professional logo design, no text, no words, no photo, no shadows
